groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Cautiously Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.592% and the 10Y at 4.933%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 2 consecutive sessions. QQQ is -1.97% over five sessions and -5.56% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +0.00% at about $113.43, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-44/100, 76% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is limited positive confirmation on the supportive side versus semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs, rising volatility as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
